newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Petroleum says returns to fall short.
newsitem.headline: NZ Petroleum says returns to fall short.

text.p: New Zealand Petroleum Ltd said on Thursday that portfolio returns for the year ended May 31, 1997, would not reach the level that had been expected.

"Directors expect an improvement on the (total) six months' result to November 30, 1996, but it is clear that the projected profit of $455,000 included in the prospectus of June 1995 will not now be achieved," NZ Petroleum said in a statement.
It said its investment manager had set about liquidating the mineral stocks which comprised 37 percent of its overall portfolio some months ago.
"This process was retarded by the Bre-X gold scandal in Indonesia and hence some delay in a decision to concentrate more closely on core investments in oil, gas and resource stocks."
